name: AutoSEO evidence-to-growth playbooks
description: Forty-one deterministic planning playbooks for discovery, authority, optimization, conversion, and local search work.

playbooks.title: Audience and outcome map
questions: Who must make progress, in what situation, and toward which measurable outcome?
Which constraints and objections change the search journey?
verification: Each segment is supported by supplied research or labeled as a hypothesis.

playbooks.title: Demand and intent research
questions: Which queries represent real demand and which page types currently satisfy them?
Where do intent and business value overlap?
verification: Every intent label cites observed results or a clearly marked heuristic.

playbooks.title: Topical coverage plan
questions: What must a trustworthy resource cover to satisfy the topic completely?
Which existing pages already own part of the topic?
deliverables: new, merge, refresh, and retire decisions
verification: The plan avoids duplicate intent and assigns one canonical owner per topic.

playbooks.title: Opportunity prioritization
questions: Which opportunities combine impact, confidence, feasibility, and strategic fit?
Which dependencies must be resolved first?
verification: Scores expose assumptions and do not imply guaranteed rankings.

playbooks.title: Keyword variation and entity map
questions: Which language variants express the same task and which imply a different page?
Which entities and modifiers recur across authoritative results?
verification: Variants are grouped by demonstrated intent rather than lexical similarity alone.

playbooks.title: Authority and link-gap analysis
questions: Which credible sources endorse competing resources but not this one?
What genuinely link-worthy evidence or utility can the site offer?
verification: Opportunities are checked for relevance, editorial legitimacy, and live-link evidence.

playbooks.title: Page optimization baseline
questions: Does the page satisfy its primary intent and expose a clear next action?
Which technical, content, and trust signals are measurably weak?
verification: Each recommendation includes current evidence and a post-change test.

playbooks.title: Core content audit
questions: What unique value, first-hand evidence, and trustworthy support does the page provide?
Where is the answer incomplete, repetitive, or unsupported?
deliverables: retain, rewrite, merge, or remove decisions
verification: Claims are traceable and subjective judgments are labeled.

playbooks.title: Technical quality review
questions: Can eligible agents fetch, render, interpret, and canonicalize the page consistently?
Which issue blocks discovery or understanding first?
verification: Critical findings are reproduced with a second signal when practical.

playbooks.title: Search click-through audit
questions: Does the result promise the right outcome without exaggeration?
What SERP features and competing messages shape the click decision?
verification: Variants remain accurate to on-page content and are evaluated over a defined window.

playbooks.title: Evidence-led article outline
questions: Which reader questions must be answered and in what dependency order?
Where must original evidence or expert review be supplied?
verification: The outline covers the primary task without padding or duplicate sections.

playbooks.title: Article drafting specification
questions: What is the shortest complete answer that preserves nuance and proof?
Which statements require citations or subject-matter approval?
verification: No invented facts, experiences, quotations, or performance claims are introduced.

playbooks.title: Supporting-page refresh
questions: How should this page strengthen the canonical topic owner?
What stale sections or links weaken that role?
verification: The refreshed page has a distinct intent and reciprocal contextual links.

playbooks.title: Answer citability review
questions: Can a passage stand alone with a clear entity, claim, context, and source?
Are important answers accessible in rendered text?
verification: Recommendations support users and conventional search as well as answer systems.

playbooks.title: Human quality review
questions: Where does the text sound generic, over-patterned, or detached from real experience?
Which passages need an accountable human decision?
verification: The review improves clarity without pretending to detect authorship reliably.

playbooks.title: Claim verification
questions: Which claims are externally verifiable, time-sensitive, or high stakes?
Does each cited source directly support the exact claim?
verification: Primary and current sources are preferred and retrieval dates are recorded.

playbooks.title: Source and author authority audit
questions: Can readers identify who is responsible and why the source is credible?
Are conflicts, methods, dates, and corrections transparent?
verification: Recommendations do not fabricate credentials or endorsements.

playbooks.title: Structured-data opportunity
questions: Which supported type accurately describes visible content?
Do identifiers connect related entities consistently?
verification: Generated markup mirrors visible content and passes deterministic validation.

playbooks.title: Question and answer reframing
questions: What task is the searcher actually trying to complete?
Can headings and answers express that task naturally without keyword repetition?
verification: Questions are supported by observed demand or clearly marked audience research.

playbooks.title: Community language research
questions: How do real users describe the problem, trade-offs, and failed alternatives?
Which language is widespread enough to inform the page?
verification: Anecdotes are not presented as representative statistics.

playbooks.title: Search competitor discovery
questions: Which pages compete for the same intent rather than merely the same product category?
What evidence explains their result fit?
verification: Competitors are selected from current evidence and not assumed from brand familiarity.

playbooks.title: Optimization opportunity qualification
questions: Is the opportunity reachable with the site's authority, assets, and constraints?
What would falsify the expected benefit?
verification: The decision states evidence, dependencies, uncertainty, and stop conditions.

playbooks.title: Search visibility baseline
questions: Which queries, surfaces, pages, and engines define current visibility?
Which measurements are comparable over time?
verification: Location, language, device, provider, and sample size are preserved.

playbooks.title: Visibility change diagnosis
questions: What changed in demand, eligibility, competition, content, links, or measurement?
Which causal explanation has direct evidence?
verification: Correlation is not reported as causation and alternative explanations remain visible.

playbooks.title: Content-gap follow-up
questions: Does the gap represent missing user value or only competitor word count?
Should it extend this page or belong elsewhere?
verification: Every addition has a user purpose and avoids intent cannibalization.

playbooks.title: Reader task validation
questions: Can each priority audience complete its next task with the information and controls provided?
Where does information scent break?
verification: Checks distinguish content, navigation, and technical causes.

playbooks.title: Editorial polish and consistency
questions: Which passages can be shorter, clearer, more concrete, or better ordered?
Are terminology and claims consistent across the page?
verification: Edits preserve meaning, evidence, brand constraints, and accessibility.

playbooks.title: Bottom-of-funnel page brief
questions: What decision is the visitor making and what proof removes the largest risk?
Which alternatives must be compared fairly?
verification: The brief avoids false urgency, unsupported superiority, and hidden trade-offs.

playbooks.title: Conversion and friction audit
questions: Where does the page lose clarity, trust, momentum, or accessibility?
Which change can be tested without harming search intent satisfaction?
verification: Experiments define guardrails, primary outcomes, and rollback conditions.

playbooks.title: Search and conversion scorecard
questions: Does the page earn qualified discovery and help that audience act?
Which improvement benefits one surface while risking the other?
verification: SEO and conversion metrics are reported separately before synthesis.

playbooks.title: Local market research
questions: Which locations, services, competitors, and local modifiers shape demand?
Which facts vary legitimately by location?
verification: Service areas and business facts are verified and doorway-page patterns are excluded.

playbooks.title: Local homepage brief
questions: What primary service, location, proof, and next action must the homepage establish?
Which supporting pages should it route to?
verification: Business name, address, phone, service area, and claims match verified records.

playbooks.title: Local homepage refresh
questions: Which current sections obscure relevance, trust, or service coverage?
What content must be retained for users and rankings?
verification: The refresh preserves factual NAP, existing valuable content, and crawlable navigation.

playbooks.title: Local service-page refresh
questions: What service evidence and local relevance are unique to this page?
How is it different from neighboring service or location pages?
verification: The result avoids templated doorway content and unverifiable local claims.

playbooks.title: Business profile category selection
questions: Which category most precisely represents the primary real-world business?
Which additional categories are supported by actual services?
verification: Selections reflect current provider options and the real business, not keyword reach alone.

playbooks.title: Business profile factual description
questions: Which verified services, history, locations, and differentiators matter most?
Which promotional claims are prohibited or unsupported?
verification: Every specific claim is verified and the text follows current profile policies.

playbooks.title: Business profile differentiation
questions: What verifiable choice criteria distinguish the business locally?
How can those facts be stated without comparative exaggeration?
verification: Differentiators are specific, current, and demonstrably true.

playbooks.title: Business profile description compliance
questions: Does the description contain prohibited promotions, links, unsupported claims, or keyword repetition?
What can be preserved safely?
verification: The final copy is checked against current official profile guidance.

playbooks.title: Business profile services
questions: Which real services deserve distinct entries and descriptions?
How should categories, website pages, and services align?
verification: Every service is actually offered and maps to an appropriate page or explanation.

playbooks.title: Local title-tag design
questions: Which service, place, and differentiator accurately summarize the page?
What competing titles set user expectations?
verification: Titles match visible content, avoid stuffing, and preserve brand requirements.

playbooks.title: Local meta-description design
questions: What verified local value and next step should the snippet communicate?
Which details improve qualification without overpromising?
verification: Descriptions are accurate, readable, non-duplicative, and consistent with the page.
